summary_sentence: Freeze detected (capture=hang, heartbeatAge=31.5s >= 30s). The game main thread was waiting for the GPU: the engine was polling a Direct3D query (ID3D11DeviceContext::GetData) in a Sleep loop (SkyrimSE.exe, KERNELBASE.dll!SleepEx). (Confidence: Low)

suspects.reason: Stack frame (main thread was waiting in SkyrimSE.exe; modules on its stack are on the call path, not shown to be the freeze cause)

recommendations: [Hang] No WCT cycle: possible infinite loop / busy wait.

[Main thread] The main thread was waiting for the GPU (the engine was polling a Direct3D query). Update or clean-install the GPU driver, then test without graphics injectors and upscalers (detected: ENB) and with lighter texture/video-memory load.
[Conflict] If multiple mods provide the same file, check the load order and overwrites.
